doc.snippet: FR-011: site can receive webmentions from other websites/blogs; rationale = federated conversation and engagement tracking; validation = endpoint functional, mentions received and stored. FR-012 (display) is OUT OF SCOPE for this story — owned by Story 2.4.

doc.title: Integration Architecture
doc.section: External Services Inventory (lines 192-195); webmention.io API call signature (lines 234-248); Pattern 2 Dual Anonymous Engagement (lines 414-432); Critical Agent Rules (lines 762-771); webmention.io API spec (lines 974-998); Implementation Checklist (line 1519)
doc.snippet: webmention.io chosen as External Service for "Federated webmention receiving" (FREE, public API, no auth). Endpoint: `https://webmention.io/api/mentions.jf2?domain={DOMAIN}`. No authentication required. Rate limits not documented (generous). Implementation Checklist line 1519: "webmention.io account created for article-time.de" — gating prerequisite for Phase 1A.

doc.title: Integration Architecture — Daily Rebuild Data Flow
doc.snippet: Webmentions flow: External blog → webmention.io endpoint (article-time.de's `<link rel="webmention">` tells senders WHERE) → mention stored at webmention.io → 24h later Story 3.2 fetches via API → data/webmentions_raw.json → process → data/webmentions_by_article.json → Story 2.4 display partial. Until Stories 3.2 and 2.4 land, mentions sit in webmention.io's dashboard but do not appear on the live site (expected, NOT a defect of Story 2.3).

doc.snippet: Phase 0 Task 4.0 already added `https://webmention.io` to `csp.connectsrc` in config/_default/params.yaml line 29. Pattern: legacy `[params.csp]` block from blog-old/config.toml ported to YAML, with Umami Cloud + webmention.io added for new external services. Task 4.0 marked complete.

constraints.constraint: Do NOT gate the `<link rel="webmention">` tag on `hugo.IsProduction`. Differs intentionally from Story 2.1's Umami snippet (which IS gated). Rationale: webmention discovery is HTML metadata, not a runtime call. Webmention senders only consume the production HTML at https://article-time.de/, never localhost — emitting in dev is harmless. AC #1 + AC #7 explicitly require identical emission in both prod and dev builds.

config/production/params.yaml line 10 redefines `csp.connectsrc` as `["'self'", "https://api.bloggify.net"]` — does NOT include `https://webmention.io`. Hugo merges environment overrides on top of `_default`, and lists at the same key REPLACE rather than concatenate. Daily-rebuild.yml builds with `--environment production` (line 122), so the override IS applied to the live site. For Story 2.3 this is INFO-priority because the `<link rel="webmention">` tag is HTML metadata — no runtime fetch, no CSP `connect-src` evaluation for the link itself. The blocker materialises in Story 2.4 if/when it makes any client-side webmention.io fetch (currently architecture says it reads from data/ at build time, so likely safe). Flag in completion notes; either fix as a follow-up Phase 0 cleanup ticket or wait until Story 2.4 forces the issue. Do NOT scope-creep into a full prod-CSP cleanup in Story 2.3.

Do NOT modify config/_default/params.yaml `csp.*` in this story. Phase 0 Task 4.0 already added `https://webmention.io` to `csp.connectsrc` (line 29). AC #6 is a regression check, NOT a change. The webmention link tag emission is unrelated to CSP enforcement.

The webmention endpoint URL `https://webmention.io/article-time.de/webmention` is hardcoded in head.html (matches epics AC #1 verbatim). Do NOT introduce a `webmention:` block in params.yaml mirroring the `umami:` block (deliberately differs from Story 2.1's pattern). Rationale: single-tenant project, URL never varies, simplest possible change for a 0.5-day story. If the project ever multi-tenants or migrates webmention provider, refactoring to a config param is a 5-minute follow-up. Document the decision in completion notes.

AC #5 requires the privacy-policy section to be added in THIS story (NOT deferred to Story 2.5). Differs from Story 2.1's Umami pattern (deferred to 2.5). Rationale: webmentions involve THIRD-PARTY DATA (sender's name, URL, avatar) being PUBLICLY DISPLAYED — this requires explicit GDPR Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. f disclosure. Story 2.5 will integrate/expand the section as part of the broader refresh; do NOT add a "Stand:" / "Last updated:" date line (Story 2.5 owns that).
No new npm dependencies. webmention.io discovery is HTML metadata only — no JS library, no Node package, no client wrapper. Do NOT add `webmention-client`, `indieweb-utils`, or similar.
Hugo v0.146+ flat layouts convention — files are at `layouts/baseof.html` and `layouts/_partials/_base/head.html`. Do NOT create `layouts/_default/baseof.html` or `layouts/_default/head.html`.
Project rule: no new jQuery code. Not directly relevant (this story adds zero JS), but reinforces "no wrapper libraries" for the webmention integration.
Webmention reception is a SITE-WIDE concern. Do NOT add per-article frontmatter (e.g., `webmention_endpoint: ...`). The `<link>` is rendered identically for every page from head.html.

webmention.io signup uses IndieAuth. The current head.html does NOT emit any `rel="me"` links. Two acceptable paths to satisfy AC #2: (a) GitHub OAuth fallback (preferred — zero code change), (b) add a 1-line `<link rel="me" href="https://github.com/AngelCrawford" />` to head.html. Option (b) is in-scope for Story 2.3 if option (a) fails; document in completion notes. Comprehensive `rel="me"` set is deferred to Story 9.10 (author-box) or 9.12 (social-follow-row).

GitHub Secret name `WEBMENTION_IO_TOKEN` (uppercase snake_case) — chosen to match existing `UMAMI_API_KEY` / `UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID` convention. Architecture doc does NOT prescribe a name. If Story 3.2 chooses a different name later, GitHub repo Settings → Secrets allows trivial rename.
Do NOT add `WEBMENTION_IO_TOKEN` to `.github/workflows/daily-rebuild.yml` `env:` block in this story. Pre-storing the secret is sufficient for AC #4. Story 3.2 owns wiring it into the workflow.

Use Hugo whitespace controls (`{{- ... -}}`) on the surrounding template lines for clean diff and clean rendered HTML. Acceptable: a single blank line above the new comment block for visual separation.

Existing head emit (CSS bundle, jquery+gdpr `bundle.js`, preload links, favicon links, SEO partial output, RSS link tag, CSP meta tag) MUST remain byte-equivalent before/after the change. Diff `public/articles/<existing-post>/index.html` pre and post; only the new `<link rel="webmention">` block (and its preceding comment) should differ — in BOTH dev and prod builds. (AC #7)

.github/workflows/daily-rebuild.yml line 50 pins Hugo `0.161.1`; integration architecture (digital-garden-integration-architecture.md line 770) recommends pinning `0.152.2`. Drift exists. Out of scope here, but worth a follow-up doc/CI ticket. Either pin satisfies this story; the snippet does not depend on a Hugo version newer than 0.115 (config/production/config.yaml `module.hugoVersion.min`).

Webmention DISPLAY (rendering received mentions on article pages) is Story 2.4's scope, not this story. Story 2.3 succeeds even if no webmention is ever displayed on the live site — AC #3 success criterion is "test mention appears in webmention.io DASHBOARD", explicitly NOT "appears on the live site".
